subject.title: Feature Request: Add MathJax/LaTeX Support to Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor first-party Control UI math rendering in core, and if so which renderer/default/config/sanitizer model should be accepted?
rationale: The feature has clear user demand and fits web frontend ergonomics, but it adds core UI rendering behavior for untrusted chat content, likely dependency or bundled asset surface, and possibly a public config option.

options.title: Sponsor one core implementation
options.body: Review one KaTeX, MathJax, or MathML implementation to completion with dependency/security approval, default/config decision, and real Control UI browser proof, then close this issue after merge.

options.title: Defer out of core
options.body: Keep core markdown unchanged unless maintainers identify a missing plugin/API seam that blocks safer external implementation.

options.title: Close as not planned
options.body: Decline first-party Control UI math rendering for now and close this issue plus candidate PRs with a clear product rationale.

recommendation.title: Sponsor one core implementation
recommendation.body: Review one KaTeX, MathJax, or MathML implementation to completion with dependency/security approval, default/config decision, and real Control UI browser proof, then close this issue after merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is product/security/config direction, and steipete is tied to the original chat markdown path plus the issue discussion.
